messages:
sanjay: quick check — planning to enable a per-customer flag `adaptive_batch_v2` for two enterprise tenants this week. need ops gating + rollout plan. targets: tenant_acme, tenant_globex (both VIPs).
elaine: do we have contract gating for globex? if their contract forbids betas we need sales/legal sign-off before enabling.
tim: i can add allowlist entries to customer_flags table. what's the exact flag name and scope? tenant-only or org-wide? also will need a canary mechanism (tenant list or percentage).
lucy: my recommendation: allowlist by tenant id (explicit list) + canary % for each tenant. start at 10% of their requests for 48h. monitor p50/p95 latency, error rate, and token cost delta.
sanjay: agree. also add automatic fallback to stable runtime/model when error_rate > 1% for 5m. set alerts in datadog + tracing hooks in console. @deploy-bot can you create the feature toggle with an allowlist + fallback metadata?
deploy-bot: created flag `adaptive_batch_v2` in prod with allowlist: [tenant_acme, tenant_globex]. canary routing configured at 10% for those tenants. flag URL: https://console.internal/flags/adaptive_batch_v2 (internal).
tim: pushing DB migration now. SQL snippet for the change:
```sql
ALTER TABLE customer_flags ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS flag_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb;
INSERT INTO customer_flags (tenant_id, flag_key, flag_metadata) VALUES ('tenant_acme', 'adaptive_batch_v2', '{"enabled":false}');
```
we'll gate enablement behind an entitlement check in middleware (customer_profile.entitlements.includes('beta_features')).
elaine: i'll confirm globex contract. if sales/legal OK we can proceed; otherwise need a different plan.
lucy: i'll run a replay from staging traffic for those tenant ids and sanity-check metrics tomorrow during a dedicated 2h window (10:00-12:00 PT).
ops-bot: heads up — maintenance window scheduled 2025-06-12 22:00 UTC. if rollout overlaps we should reschedule.
sanjay: thanks — let's avoid that window. move main rollout to 2025-06-13 02:00 UTC if needed. tim, tag me when migration PR is ready; i'll be on watch for the manual canary enable.
tim: PR created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/inference/+/1234 — CI green. i'll apply migration, then enable middleware, then flip flag to 10% allowlist.
elaine: confirmed with sales — globex allows opt-in pilots with 7-day notice. legal signed off.
lucy: rollout plan recap: 1) apply migration, 2) deploy middleware changes, 3) enable flag allowlist for tenant_acme/globex at 10%, 4) monitor metrics for 48h, 5) increase to 100% if no regressions. rollback plan: disable flag + revert middleware if error_rate > 1% sustained for 5m or p95 latency increases >20%.
sanjay: sounds good. if anyone sees weird spikes ping #oncall immediately and add any suspicious traces to the console trace view. closing this thread after rollout but tag me for the final green. :thumbsup:
